title: I/O manager phase-0 landing
summary: Land the first implementation slice for the I/O manager without changing live filesystem semantics: introduce staged request/plan/queue values, PageSlot and RangeReservation scaffolding, focused tests, and a compatibility path that keeps current FsPageBacking implementations valid.

write_sets.notes: Owns PageSlot, RangeReservation, SparseIndex staging, and PageContainer internal synchronization. Must not edit concrete filesystem crates in the same slice.
Owns request, plan, queue, runtime, and service-future skeletons. Must not import tx-ext4 or tx-fs concrete backends.
Owns Bio/BioPlan mapping experiments for bdev-fs after a later worktree claims crates/tx-fs/src/bdevfs/. Current active network plan claims crates/tx-fs/src/, so phase 0 must not claim that path.
Only starts after BioPlan values are proven through bdev-fs. Keeps ext4 as mapper/journal/backend owner, not a generic file-data cache.
Owns plan state, readiness updates, verification summaries, and scope arbitration.

steps.title: Record canonical gate and first landing order
steps.notes: This preparation slice records that phase 0 is implementation-ready as compatibility scaffolding. It deliberately does not change live FsPageBacking, BlockDeviceOps, or PageContainer behavior.

steps.title: Add io_manager value types and module skeleton
steps.notes: Complete. Added io_manager::{page,backend,block,runtime} and fs_iface::plan as pure value/queue scaffolding. Tests cover page priority admission, empty/full page queue rejection, neutral backend plan re-export, adjacent LBA merge, queue-depth rejection, and barrier fence dispatch. The only concrete-path strings found by the import scan are compatibility prose in io_manager/mod.rs, not imports or call sites.

steps.title: Add PageSlot and RangeReservation staging modules
steps.notes: Complete. Added PageSlot as a per-slot locked state machine with Empty, Resident, Fetching, Dirty, Writeback, Error, and PageGeneration tracking. Added RangeReservationTable as an owner-locked interval table for logical page-range semantic exclusion. Tests cover same-page fetch dedup, stale generation completion rejection, dirty/writeback/error transitions, range overlap rejection, shared read admission, and release-before-yield retry. The live PageContainer materialize/fetch/flush path is unchanged.

steps.title: Add L6 Bio queue semantics over current BlockDeviceHandle
steps.notes: Complete. Extended the staged L6 BlockQueue with front/back adjacent merge, request-tag allocation, tag-to-request completion lookup, QueueDepth completion accounting, and a tagged dispatch path that prevents ordinary I/O from crossing an in-flight barrier/fence. Added a neutral BlockServiceDriver turn that drains dispatchable Bio work under ServiceBudget, returns BlockDispatch values, and re-kicks only while L6 backlog remains immediately dispatchable; it does not know PageIoRequest or concrete driver execution. Added BlockDispatchExecutor, BlockDeviceCompletion, and BlockCompletionSource as the L6/L7 seam: future device executors consume BlockDispatch and report tag/result completions back to BlockTagTable without making io_manager::block import BlockDeviceHandle, BlockDeviceOps, concrete filesystems, or drivers. Existing BlockDeviceHandle and BlockDeviceOps remain unchanged; drivers are still later executors, not part of this control-plane slice.

steps.title: Make bdev-fs produce BioPlan through compatibility adapter
verification: git diff --check -- crates/tx-fs/src/bdevfs/mod.rs crates/tx-subsystems/src/io_manager crates/tx-subsystems/src/fs_iface docs/progress/plans/2026-07-11-io-manager-phase0-landing.json docs/progress/STATUS.md
steps.notes: Complete. Added bdevfs-owned plan_page_bio and plan_barrier_bio helpers that map a bdev-fs FsObjectId plus page offset to neutral io_manager::block::BioPlan values. The helpers do not submit to the driver and the existing FsPageBacking fetch/flush/fsync path remains the live compatibility executor.

steps.title: Connect PageContainer miss path to staged L4 queue behind compatibility seam
steps.notes: Complete for the compatibility-seam phase. The staged L4/L6 path now has PageService admission/completion, BackendPlanner IR dispatch, PageSlot generation checks, owned FileIoBlockRuntime, device-layer BlockDeviceHandle dispatch outside PageContainer locks, an aggregate file-I/O service turn, StepOp wrapper, borrowed and owned service task loops, a device-owned PageContainerFileIoServiceRuntime registry, bdevfs registration on newly materialised coherent PageContainers, and kernel init submission of registered owned runtimes into BOOT_REACTOR. Demand misses still fall back to direct FsPageBacking when no backend planner or no installing planned completion path exists; that fallback is the intended compatibility path for this phase. Ext4 planning and full hot-path deletion remain Phase 6+ work.

steps.title: Refactor ext4 fetch/flush toward PageIoPlan/BioPlan
steps.notes: Ext4 remains the mapping, metadata, and journal backend. Generic file-data readahead stays in L4/PageContainer.
